items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We made a record in Philly, Al Steele’s Allstars, on some obscure label

ctx.x: Because you’re on so many great dates.

Well, that was after though, you gotta remember. I made a terrible record in Paris with Maggie in ’48. I didn’t know doo-doo man, I didn’t really know anything. I had only been playing a year and a half, close to two years, so I should never have been recording. We made a record in Philly, Al Steele’s Allstars, on some obscure label, and then this one in Paris. And at that time, I played a trio record with Sardaby?
Michel Sardaby, yeah. A great French pianist.
